Correction release for the interruption-study entry, in English and 简体中文.

The 2005 observation's overall same-day return interval is **25 minutes 26 seconds**, with SD 54 minutes 48 seconds, on printed page 326. It excludes interruptions in the final working hour and does not measure time needed to refocus. The popular 23-minute recovery claim remains **Not supported, Grade B**. [Primary paper](https://ics.uci.edu/~gmark/CHI2005.pdf).

This release regenerates both PDF books, the offline reader, claim data, Agent Skill, and sharing cards with the corrected evidence and limits. Counts remain 58 claims, 125 sources, nine chapters; grades A/B/C remain 0/26/32. v0.1.0's tag and assets are retained as the original edition.

The source-verification report is tied to this release commit. Its checks cover metadata, registered abstract snippets, or link-only checks according to each source's declared level. The release gate requires every result OK, with no warnings or failures. Full-text statistics, causal interpretations and evidence grades are not machine-validated. The Mark figure above was separately read in the original PDF; this is not expert line-by-line review of the handbook.

中文更正：Mark 等人 2005 年观察中，同日回到被打断工作的平均间隔为 25 分 26 秒，标准差 54 分 48 秒。统计排除最后工作小时的打断，没有测量恢复专注时间。两本 PDF、离线阅读器、数据、Skill 和分享图均重新生成；v0.1.0 历史文件保留。
